cutover.title: Switch sources to prepared targets (reviewed cutover)
cutover.subtitle: Review exactly what moves and when. Nothing changes until you confirm, and the current group keeps recording until the boundary.
cutover.no_source: No running group can be switched or rolled back.
cutover.no_targets: No prepared target yet. Prepare one in Basic with "Prepare targets for a reviewed cutover".
cutover.boundary_hint: The current group's window is cut at this exact instant and the new group starts there. Both boundary windows are marked partial.
cutover.rollback_candidates: Switches that can be rolled back
cutover.no_rollback: No switch has been recorded for this group.
cutover.rollback_note: A rollback uses a new boundary. Both histories and every table stay as they are, and rows already accepted by the targets are still written to their own table.
cutover.stale: The selection, boundary or saved groups changed after this review. Review again before confirming.
cutover.moved: {{count}} source(s) move to the selected targets.
cutover.unselected: {{count}} source(s) are not selected and stay in the current group.
cutover.remaining: The current group's saved draft keeps {{count}} source(s).
cutover.explain_truncation: The current group's window is cut at the boundary and marked partial. The new window starts at the boundary and is also partial.
cutover.explain_drain: Rows the current group already accepted are still written to its original table.
cutover.explain_baseline: Cumulative targets build a new baseline at the boundary: their first record has no difference.
cutover.scheduled: Scheduled. The switch takes effect at {{boundary}}. Until then the current group keeps recording and nothing has moved.
cutover.boundary_reached: The boundary {{boundary}} is recorded. Check each group's status for what is collecting and what is committed to SQL.
cutover.failed: The switch was not applied. The current group keeps recording unchanged.
cutover.unknown: The answer was lost. The switch may or may not have been recorded, and nothing is assumed.
cutover.check_none: No matching recorded switch was found.
cutover.check_failed: The recorded switches could not be read. Try again.
cutover.resend: Send the same reviewed request again

errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Nothing was changed.

errors.cutover_not_applicable: The reviewed switch can no longer be applied. Review again.

roles.title: What Advanced and the workspace are for
roles.advanced: Advanced edits the same saved profile of each circuit: the canonical source mapping, custom layouts and confirmed signed or rollover counter policies. It is not another table format and has no separate recording period.
roles.workspace: The workspace is where readiness and activation are reviewed for the saved groups together. Saving a setting does not apply it or start recording: an applied version keeps writing until a new one is applied, and a saved or unsaved draft records nothing.

status.title: Recording status
Recording status
status.not_applied: Not applied yet: nothing is recorded until this profile is applied.
status.query_failed: The recording status could not be read. Nothing is assumed written.
status.evidence_not_current: These records belong to another applied revision, so they are not shown as current.
status.evidence_unavailable: Per source results are not available for this applied revision.
status.source_none: No record is available for this source yet, or it was already cleaned up. This is not a zero or a failure.
status.destination_changed: This record was frozen to a different destination revision and is not credited to the current one.
status.applied_destination_note: Results below belong to the applied version. A new destination draft has not taken effect yet.
status.readback_not_checked: SQL readback has not been checked separately.
status.storage_history_uncertain: The missing managed table was recreated. Recording can continue, but earlier history may be lost. Recreated structure and retained receipts do not prove historical rows were restored.

profile.title: Recording profile (same as Basic)
profile.members_note_wide: Columns are created from the selected sources and fixed; a source without a value is stored as NULL with its reason.
profile.note: These are the saved settings of this circuit group, the same ones Basic edits. The period is kept in its own unit and is not a second seconds setting. The layout and its table are fixed once created (a long table also fixes its storage mode); change the period in Basic.
profile.members_note: Columns are fixed by the shared long layout. A source with no value is stored as NULL with a reason, so there is no per-source required setting or skip-row policy here.

policy.title: Counter policy (signed and rollover)
policy.note: The confirmed policy of each cumulative source, saved to its measurement definition. Values are exact decimal text. A signed counter may report negative differences; a rollover (wrap) policy applies only to an unsigned integer counter. The server decides whether a change starts a new series.
policy.load_failed: The counter definitions could not be loaded.
policy.missing: has no confirmed counter meaning. Confirm it in Basic first; nothing is created here.
policy.unconfirmed: The saved policy of this definition is not valid yet, so it is not the confirmed runtime policy. Saving a valid policy confirms it; the server has the final say.
policy.open_basic: Go to this source in Basic
policy.open_basic_unavailable: The counter confirmation of this source is not shown in Basic for the selected circuit. Select its circuit in Basic first.
policy.saved: Saved. The definition revision above is the server answer.
policy.epoch_started: Saved. The server started a new series epoch, so the next reading begins a new baseline.

issue.modulus_invalid: The modulus must be a positive exact decimal of at most 64 characters.
issue.rate_invalid: The maximum rate must be a positive exact decimal of at most 64 characters.
issue.rate_needs_modulus: A maximum rate needs a rollover modulus.
issue.rollover_with_signed: A signed counter cannot keep a rollover policy. Clear the modulus and the rate first.
issue.rollover_with_float: A floating point counter cannot use a rollover policy.

members.metadata_forbidden: The saved connection may not read this table's columns. Grant the permission, then retry.
members.metadata_failed: The table columns could not be read. Retry; no sample columns are substituted.
members.none: No saved Tag can be grouped yet.
members.none_shown: No row matches the current search or filter.
members.required_label: {{tag}} is required for a complete row
members.problem_column_conflict: This column is shared with another Tag in the same row.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.none: Save the group to check its readiness.
readiness.stale_draft: This describes the last saved version, not your unsaved edits.

lifecycle.review_start_note: Taking this group live has one entry: go back to this device's Basic view, review what is saved and start there. Nothing is applied or started from here.
lifecycle.apply_note: Apply starts writing from the next time bucket. It does not create tables and does not prove anything was written; check delivery for that.
lifecycle.delete_keeps: Accepted data, its history and delivery records are kept and can still be viewed. The group stops accepting new data.
lifecycle.delete_impact: {{count}} row(s) are still waiting or unresolved and will keep their destination.
lifecycle.delete_impact_unknown: What is still waiting could not be read. Accepted data is kept either way.

test_write.title: Test write
test_write.intro: Writes one clearly marked test row to the real table, reads it back, then removes only that row. Nothing is written until you confirm.
test_write.cleanup_note: Only the row marked as this test is removed afterwards; your other rows are never touched.
test_write.running: Still running. Check again for the result.
test_write.cleanup_failed: Cleanup failed; the test row may remain
test_write.unconfirmed: The result was not confirmed. The test row may or may not have been written; check its status instead of writing again.
test_write.blocked_unsaved: Save the group before a test write.
test_write.blocked_dirty: Save your changes first; a test write uses the saved group.
test_write.blocked_destination: This group points at a different destination than the saved connection.
test_write.blocked_readonly: Setup is read-only while activation is running.

summary.unknown: The write groups could not be read, so database output is unconfirmed.
summary.none: No write group exists. Collection can start, but nothing is written to the database.
summary.saved_not_applied: {{count}} write group(s) saved but not applied. Nothing is written to the database yet.
summary.applied: {{applied}} of {{total}} write group(s) applied. Applied is not the same as delivered; check delivery for what the database confirmed.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.failed: Delivery status could not be read; values below are unconfirmed.
delivery.note: Saved, applied, stored locally and confirmed by the database are different things. Only the last one proves rows reached the table.

recovery.title: Rows needing a decision
recovery.blocked: Delivery blocked: repair the destination before retrying.
recovery.quarantined: The destination rejected this row. Repair its cause or explicitly skip it.
recovery.unknown: Delivery is uncertain. Check destination evidence; retry and skip are unavailable.
recovery.confirm_skip: I understand this row will remain recorded locally and will not be delivered.
recovery.skip: Do not deliver this row again
recovery.failed: The decision is unconfirmed. Check status or repeat this same decision safely.

proposal.title: {{count}} selected Tag(s) have no column in this table
proposal.intro: Choose another table, remove those Tags from the group, or plan the new columns below. Planned columns are proposals only; nothing is assigned or created until you decide.
proposal.managed_intro: These are the columns the managed table would need. They are a proposal for you to review, not columns that exist.
proposal.label: (proposal — not in the table)
proposal.options: Nothing is added to the group or the table from here.

workspace_readiness.title: Workspace Status
workspace_readiness.ready: Activation is available. Warnings do not block apply.
workspace_readiness.no_issues: No blockers or warnings are currently reported.

workspace_readiness.solution_step1: Go to Step 1 to test or fix the device connection so the backend has a runnable device config.
workspace_readiness.solution_step2: Go to Step 2 to create or fix source rules so valid points can be generated.
workspace_readiness.solution_point_missing: Re-save this source rule so the backend rebuilds the missing derived point and link.
workspace_readiness.solution_step3: Go to Step 3 to complete point and tag mappings so values can project into runtime.
workspace_readiness.solution_step4: Go to Step 4 to enable database targets, or fix the connector/schema before applying.

runtime_return.title: Runtime reported a fix in {{step}}
runtime_return.description: You are back at the setup location reported by Runtime. Saved setup stays loaded; you do not need to rerun earlier steps.
runtime_return.point_missing_action: Re-save this source rule to rebuild the missing derived point and link.
